recs.stt: Ask HN: What's the most life-changing blog post you've ever read?
Ask HN: Is it true that any community that grows big enough, gets ruined?
recs.x: I think this is a really good video. It might not apply to everything you are thinking about, and is mainly centered around the fighting game community. But I think it can say a lot about the behaviors that we all do to try and keep a community - and how limiting who is considered a part of it is a vital part in a community. [link]
